listitem.para: ACTIVE: Session created, user is interacting
EXPIRED: Session exceeded idle or absolute timeout and is no longer usable
6604: Resource limit exceeded (e.g., max concurrent sessions)

sect2.title: Thread Safety
sect2.para: All public methods are thread-safe (internal mutex protection). Persistence backend is assumed thread-safe. Expired or terminated sessions are removed from active storage fail-closed; only state-change timestamps remain for audit/teardown diagnostics.
